BiblicalUsage: To cease, to disappear — money failing in Egypt in the famine, and Joseph answering that the cattle would do; the extortioner coming to an end in Isaiah's vision; and the psalmist asking whether God's mercy is clean gone for ever. The word asks what happens when the supply runs out.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the psalmist's question is mine too, in the lean years: is his mercy clean gone for ever? And I hold that the answer of the whole psalm is no — the God who remembered Joseph in the famine remembers his mercy too.
